Exercise 1

Graphic I
```{r}
#| message: false
library(vegawidget)
library(vegabrite)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)

df <- read_csv("https://calvin-data304.netlify.app/data/swd-lets-practice-ex-2-3.csv")
df_long <- df |> pivot_longer(c(demand, capacity), names_to = "type", values_to = "value")

vl_chart(df_long, width = 400, height = 300) |>
  vl_mark_bar() |>
  vl_encode_x("date:O") |>
  vl_encode_xOffset("type:N") |>
  vl_encode_y("value:Q") |>
  vl_encode_fill("type:N")
```

Graphic III
```{r}
#| message: false
library(vegawidget)
library(vegabrite)
library(readr)

df <- read_csv("https://calvin-data304.netlify.app/data/swd-lets-practice-ex-2-3.csv")

layerD <- vl_chart() |> 
  vl_mark_bar(width = 10, color = "coral") |>
  vl_encode_x("date:O") |>
  vl_encode_y("demand:Q", title = "Dmeand(Orange)")

layerC <- vl_chart() |> 
  vl_mark_bar(width = 20, color = "steelblue") |>
  vl_encode_x("date:O") |>
  vl_encode_y("capacity:Q", title = "Capacity(Blue)")

(layerD + layerC) |>
  vl_add_data(values = df) |>
  as_vegaspec()
```

```{r}

library(vegawidget)

library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

jobs_url <- "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/vega-datasets@2.8.0/data/jobs.json"
jobs <- fromJSON(jobs_url)
```
\
Exercise 2a
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

jobs |>
  group_by(year, sex) |>
  summarise(total_perc = sum(perc), .groups = "drop") |>
  vl_chart(width = 400, height = 300) |>
  vl_mark_point() |>
  vl_encode_x("year:O") |>
  vl_encode_y("total_perc:Q") |>
  vl_encode_color("sex:N") |>
  as_vegaspec()
```
From the Graphic above, I am able to realise a pattern in the total_perc field. The sum of the total_perc for men and women is equal to 1. This means perc is the fraction of the people in that job depending on their gender.
\
Exercise 2b
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
jobs |>
  filter(year %in% c(1850, 1900, 1940, 2000)) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = sex, values_from = perc, id_cols = c(job, year)) |>
  vl_chart(width = 200, height = 200) |>
  vl_mark_point() |>
  vl_encode_x("men:Q") |>
  vl_axis_x(format = ".0%") |>
  vl_encode_y("women:Q") |>
  vl_axis_y(format = ".0%") |>
  vl_facet_column("year:O", title = "") |>
  vl_encode_tooltip_array(list("job", "men", "women")) |>
  as_vegaspec()
```
\
Exercise 2c
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
jobs |>
  filter(year %in% c(1850, 1900, 1940, 2000)) |>
  group_by(year, sex) |>
  mutate(perc_of_sex = count / sum(count)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = sex, values_from = perc_of_sex, id_cols = c(job, year)) |>
  vl_chart(width = 200, height = 200) |>
  vl_mark_point() |>
  vl_encode_x("men:Q") |>
  vl_axis_x(format = ".0%") |>
  vl_encode_y("women:Q") |>
  vl_axis_y(format = ".0%") |>
  vl_facet_column("year:O", title = "") |>
  vl_encode_tooltip_array(list("job", "men", "women")) |>
  as_vegaspec()
```

Exercise 3
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(vegawidget)
library(vegabrite)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

gas_url <- "https://calvin-data304.netlify.app/data/pump_price_for_gasoline_us_per_liter.csv"
countries_url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lukes/ISO-3166-Countries-with-Regional-Codes/master/all/all.csv"

gas <- read_csv(gas_url)
countries <- read_csv(countries_url)

# Converting to long, per gallon, join with countries
gas_long <- gas |>
  pivot_longer(-country, names_to = "year", values_to = "price_per_liter", values_transform = list(price_per_liter = as.numeric)) |>
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(year),
    price_per_gallon = price_per_liter * 3.785
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(price_per_gallon))

# Joining on name
gas_joined <- gas_long |>
  left_join(countries, by = c("country" = "name"))

# Check unmatched countries
unmatched <- gas_joined |>
  filter(is.na(region)) |>
  distinct(country)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Most recent year available per country
gas_2016 <- gas_joined |>
  filter(year == 2016, !is.na(region))

# Chart: price by country, colored by region, using alpha-3 code as label
gas_2016 |>
  vl_chart(width = 600, height = 400) |>
  vl_mark_point() |>
  vl_encode_x("price_per_gallon:Q") |>
  vl_axis_x(title = "Price per Gallon (USD)") |>
  vl_encode_y("region:N") |>
  vl_encode_color("region:N") |>
  vl_encode_tooltip_array(list("country", "alpha-3", "region", "price_per_gallon")) |>
  as_vegaspec()
```
